description.id: Mengembangkan dan mengelola arsitektur aplikasi ritel, integrasi queue management, serta penerapan pipeline CI/CD untuk memastikan pengiriman fitur yang andal dan terukur.
description.en: Developing and managing retail application architecture, queue management integration, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable and scalable feature delivery.

id: Mengembangkan fitur web dan backend menggunakan Laravel, TypeScript, Vue.js, dan AngularJS
Menerapkan Queue Management dan pipeline Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
Mendukung pengembangan aplikasi mobile multi-platform dengan React Native dan Ionic Framework
en: Developed web and backend features using Laravel, TypeScript, Vue.js, and AngularJS
Implemented Queue Management and Continuous Integration & Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
Supported multi-platform mobile application development with React Native and Ionic Framework

description.id: Fokus pada pengembangan API backend yang andal, pemodelan database relasional, serta kolaborasi tim pengembang dengan metodologi Scrum.
description.en: Focused on developing robust backend APIs, relational database modeling, and developer team collaboration using Scrum methodology.

id: Membangun RESTful API performan tinggi menggunakan PHP dan framework Laravel
Merancang struktur basis data relasional dan optimasi query database
Berpartisipasi aktif dalam sprint harian, sprint planning, dan code review berbasis Agile/Scrum
en: Built high-performance RESTful APIs using PHP and Laravel framework
Designed relational database structures and optimized database queries
Actively participated in daily standups, sprint planning, and code reviews based on Agile/Scrum

description.id: Program intensif fullstack web development mencakup perancangan basis data, arsitektur MVC, integrasi API, dan pembuatan antarmuka responsif.
description.en: Intensive fullstack web development program covering database design, MVC architecture, API integration, and responsive UI creation.

id: Mengembangkan aplikasi web fullstack berbasis PHP, Laravel, MySQL, dan Vue.js
Melakukan pengujian serta dokumentasi endpoint API menggunakan Postman
Menerapkan standar arsitektur Model-View-Controller (MVC), Git version control, dan styling responsif dengan Bootstrap & CSS
en: Developed fullstack web applications using PHP, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue.js
Conducted API endpoint testing and documentation using Postman
Applied Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture standards, Git version control, and responsive styling with Bootstrap & CSS

description.id: Menjalankan proses operasional produksi dengan standar kualitas tinggi, koordinasi tim kerja, serta dokumentasi administrasi berkala.
description.en: Managed production operational processes with high quality standards, team coordination, and periodic administrative documentation.

id: Bekerja secara solid dalam tim untuk memastikan ketercapaian target produksi manufaktur secara konsisten
Mengelola pencatatan data dan rekapitulasi operasional menggunakan Microsoft Excel
en: Collaborated effectively within teams to consistently achieve manufacturing production targets
Managed operational data tracking and record-keeping using Microsoft Excel
